message.content:
**Company:** Mutiara Delima Bakery Sdn. Bhd. (formerly known as Gemilang Ventures Sdn. Bhd.) – a private limited company incorporated on 1995‑08‑28, currently active in Kuala Lumpur. The business operates cafés and coffee shops in Penang under the Food & Beverage industry, with a share capital of RM500.00k.

**Director & Shareholder:** The board consists of 5 directors and there are 4 shareholders. The largest shareholder is Director 1, owning 50.59 % of the shares.

**Financials:** In the latest year 2024, revenue fell by -7.4 % from RM2249.83k to RM2083.98k. Gross profit margin contracted to 52.0 % (RM1084.52k) while operating profit margin slumped to -11.2 % (RM‑232.29k). Free cash flow was negative at RM‑205.75k and net debt stood at RM659.21k, indicating a deteriorating cash generation profile and growing leverage.

**Litigation:** Two court cases were recorded. As defendant, the company faced one debt‑recovery suit (claim RM106.90k) which was dismissed. As plaintiff, it pursued one debt‑recovery claim (claim RM519.80k) that was settled. The overall status of the cases is Dismissed and Settled.

**Review Rating:** 2/5 – *High‑risk review priority.* The company is active but shows declining sales, negative operating and free cash flows, and a growing net debt position, while also having material defendant litigation.
